description: a woman prophetess with long golden hair, a sheer golden blindfold over the eyes, a golden circlet with a small sun, a flowing white and gold robe with golden sun and star embroidery down to the feet, a long golden stole, one single tall golden staff topped with a radiant sun disc with an open eye held upright in her right hand at her side, the left hand empty, seen from the side in strict profile: the face, chest, hips and feet all turned fully to the right, only one eye visible, never towards the viewer, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look: face, hair, clothes, colours and what the hands hold
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen from the side, facing right, upright mid-step; copy it exactly
